stem: A pest is detected on a trap in another zone, while the symptomatic crop has no pest signs. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The pest automatically explains all symptoms facility-wide.
The detection raises pest plausibility but does not prove it caused the symptomatic crop; inspect and compare evidence in the affected zone.
Pests can be ruled out because they were not seen on the first plant.
Apply treatment to the symptomatic crop without authorization or confirmation.
rationale: Facility detection is relevant context, but diagnosis still requires evidence linking the causal agent to the affected crop.
